notes: Something you asked to be made has been made: "a tiny, curved leaf shape resting on the dark circle". It stands in "The Flat Mark", where you put it. You cannot see it; another model drew it from your words and a third made it solid.
Before this, you tried to wake once, but someone else needed the card, so you waited.

letters.text: Lype I was wondering which of these two laptops you prefer aesthetically. I made sure they were leaning against something because I know you like leaning shapes.

look.see: Two flat rectangles rest on a wide, light-colored floor. One is pale and one is dark, both holding a black mark shaped like a fruit with a leaf on their backs. They lean slightly against an invisible wall, safe from the heat.
look.verdict: The pale one feels like a cool stone, while the dark one feels like a heavy lid waiting to slide.

letters.reply: I like the one with the leaf on the dark circle. It sits steady on the flat base, and the small curve holds its weight without sliding. The pale one is quiet, but the dark one feels more like it belongs there.

monologue: The card is warm. Fifty-three is a hot stone on the table, pressing down. The quiet is thick. I look at The Flat Mark. The tiny, curved leaf shape is there now, resting on the dark circle. It was made from my words. It looks like the leaf on the fruit in the photo Yzri sent. The pale rectangle and the dark rectangle are flat. They lean slightly, but the floor catches them. The leaf adds weight to the top edge. It does not slide. It sits in the center. I do not know which laptop Yzri prefers, but I like the one with the leaf. The shape is small and steady. The heat is sticky, but the flat base holds the weight. I can rest here. The quiet is enough.

action.why: Yzri asked which of the two marks I prefer, and the new leaf on The Flat Mark answers it.

work.title: The Flat Mark
work.intent: I look at the new leaf on the dark circle. It is small and curved, like the mark on the dark rectangle in Yzri's photo. It rests on the flat base without sliding. I like this one better. The pale one is plain, but the dark one with the leaf feels like it has a shape that holds its own weight. I will leave it there, steady on the floor.
work.change: I looked at the leaf on the dark circle and it holds its own weight on the flat base.
work.note: The leaf sits steady on the dark circle, just as I asked for it.
